sources.title: Cloud Run GPU jobs resource requirements
facts: Full RTX PRO 6000 minimum 20 vCPU / 80 GiB; these are provider minima, not profiled Cam stage needs.
L4 minimum 4 vCPU / 16 GiB; requires separate CUDA/NVENC/model qualification.
Fractional RTX preview minimum 10 vCPU / 40 GiB; not a qualified default.

sources.title: Cloud Run pricing
facts: USD on-demand reference; CPU, memory and GPU all count.
Jobs and instance-based services have a one-minute minimum including startup/lifetime.
Same-region Google Cloud traffic is not charged as internet egress.

sources.title: Cloud Storage pricing
facts: Storage and network are separate costs.
Use explicit download/retention assumptions; region/route/volume matter.
